Comment: Attachments: swapping is a workshop job, not an inventory toggle. Effects are the coefficients the snow contact and task models read; GrantsRoles is what the host machine can do with it mounted.

attachments.Comment: Six-way 3.5 m groomer blade: lift, angle, tilt. The light cat's blade.
Twelve-way 4.3 m blade with side wings: cuts moguls, carries 4 t of snow, shapes berms.
Twelve-way 5.0 m blade for the heavy cats: more snow carried per pass on wide runs.
U-shaped blade that holds twice the snow of a straight blade: snow farming and pushing at the base.
Truck V-plow: breaks through drifts in V, scoops in the other setting. 3.4 m cleared.
Front plow plus a hydraulic side wing: 5.5 m of road per pass. Tandem trucks only.
Light straight plow for pickups and compact tractors: the lodge lot and the sidewalks.
Containment box for loaders and tractors: moves a whole lane of lot snow to the dump without spill.
4.3 m power tiller with finisher comb: re-lays the surface at 430 kg/m3 and prints the corduroy. Four lanes on a 40 m run.
6.0 m tiller with folding side sections: three lanes instead of four on a 40 m run. Needs a 330 kW cat.
Park tiller with a fine-cut rotor and a heavier comb: firmer, smoother surface for take-offs and landings.
Renovator and dual classic track setter with a skating lane: the nordic loop's whole kit.
Park blade with extra tilt and a cutting edge for shaping kickers and lips.
Halfpipe cutter: 6.7 m walls, one wall per pass. Only the park cat or a winch cat carries it.
4.5 t roof winch with 1,000 m of rope: the cat climbs 100 % grades with the tracks only steering.
5 t winch with 1,200 m of rope for the flagship winch cat.
Hydraulic two-stage blower head for wheel loaders: 2.4 m intake, 25 m throw, about 550 t/h.
PTO-driven blower for tractors: 2.2 m intake, 20 m throw, about 300 t/h.
Light-material bucket for wheel loaders: 2.5 m3 of snow per scoop.
4 m3 light-material bucket for the large loader.
Forks for loaders and telehandlers: carriers, cabins, parts pallets, gun crates.
Grapple for loaders and excavators: corridor clearing, moving tower sections.
Hydraulic angle broom: the last centimetre off the lodge deck and the lot in spring.
Hydraulic auger: hydrant posts, fence posts, gun tower anchors.
Rear hopper spreader with spinner: 4 m3 of salt or sand at 120 kg per lane-km.
Slide-in brine tank and spray bar: anti-icing the road before the storm.
Pintle hitch for trailers, fuel sleds and the rope reel.
Trailer-mounted rope reel: pays out haul rope along the lift line during splicing.
Jib for loaders and telehandlers: lifts sheave assemblies and gun heads onto towers.
Snowmobile hitch for the rescue toboggan or a fuel sled.
Trailer light tower with a 4-lamp mast: night construction and the lot after dark.
Small towed pump skid: 12 L/s to reach a hydrant line the pump house cannot pressurise.
Mulcher head for corridor and run clearing in the off-season.
